Forked subagent.d: In Claude Code, a subagent that inherits the whole conversation so far instead of starting fresh, so it needs no re-explaining. Only its final result comes back. Start one with /subtask.

Hook event.d: A named moment in a Claude Code session at which hooks can run, such as PreToolUse (before a tool runs), PostToolUse (after it succeeds) or SessionStart.

Hook matcher.d: The filter on a Claude Code hook that decides which occurrences of an event trigger it, for example "Edit|Write" to run only when Claude edits or writes a file.

Plugin manifest.d: The file .claude-plugin/plugin.json that gives a Claude Code plugin its name (the only required field), and optionally a version, description, author and other details.

Output style.d: In Claude Code, a set of instructions that changes Claude's role, tone and response format for a whole session, such as the built-in Concise or Explanatory styles, or a custom Markdown file.

Status line.d: A customisable line under the Claude Code prompt, produced by a script that reads session details (model, folder, context used) as JSON and prints one line of text.
